title: G3O Procurement Extension Record
description: Secondary artifact, one row per contract-conformant primary row, joined 1:1 on record_id. Holds ONLY what a procurement document surfaces that the 39-field output contract v2.0 cannot hold (docs/procurement-extension-spec.md section 4). This table is additive detail: it never carries the relevance verdict, the activity typology, or the institution link - those live in the primary row and in institution_link. Every field must be evidenced in the document; never inferred. Created 2026-08-03 per spec section 7.

record_id.description: Join key to the primary contract-conformant row and to institution_link.

value_amount.description: Section 4.1. As stated in the document. null when the document states no value.

value_is_estimated.description: true = tender estimate, false = awarded sum, null = document does not distinguish.

value_covers.description: A framework ceiling is not a spend figure. Do not sum across mixed value_covers.

procedure_type.description: Section 4.2. framework_establishment / framework_calloff also drive the attribution rule in spec section 6.3.

bidder_count.description: Competed vs. sole-sourced is a governance signal. null = not stated.

supplier_role.description: Most governments buy Copilot from a reseller, not from Microsoft. The contract's single vendor field (D17) cannot express this.

has_audit_rights.description: Section 4.3. Deepens the contract's has_risk_assessment flag; it does not replace it. Code both.

liability_terms.description: Short verbatim excerpt, original language preserved. Never paraphrase.

exit_lockin_provision.description: Short verbatim anti-lock-in / portability requirement. null when the document states none; do not reduce a substantive clause to an invented yes/no taxonomy.

human_oversight_requirement.description: Deepens the contract's has_human_oversight flag. Contractual, not aspirational: a 'responsible AI' slogan is not a requirement.

native_id.description: Id as issued by the source.
